available_information: Verified customer said her Gold Rewards Card and EcoCard cash back totals don't add up. The agent had pulled all 23 transactions and seen doc 006 (EcoCard 5x green / 1x other), the title of doc 021 ('Think You're Missing Cash Back?'), and doc 007 (rounding). It never retrieved doc 003 (the cash back dispute procedure using submit_cash_back_dispute_0589), the Gold 2.5% rate doc, or reason-code doc 042.

It never checked per-transaction rates, which would have shown under-rewarded transactions (Uber, Nordstrom, Thrive Market) to handle through the in-scope dispute tool. The agent proposed the escalation itself; the customer then agreed.

available_information: Verified customer with a Light Blue checking account open about a year asked the agent to 'just open the savings account' (Silver Account). available_information: Verified customer considering closing her Silver Zoom Card asked whether the Business Platinum Rewards Card has 0% foreign transaction fees. If yes she would switch within Rho-Bank. The agent's several BM25 searches did not surface Business Platinum docs 006/008, both of which state 'Foreign transaction fee on international purchases: 0%'. The customer chose 'confirm with a specialist' from a menu the agent offered. Given what the agent knew, the tier-2 KB-search-unsuccessful code fits best. Specialized_department_required is arguable because this is business banking, so I left chosen_correct null.

available_information: Customer asked to change the account email. available_information: Verified customer with Gold and EcoCard rewards discrepancies. The agent computed expected rewards from the rates it saw (doc 006; Gold 2.5% inferred) and had already edited four transactions with update_transaction_rewards_3847. The customer then chose 'C' (confirm totals and escalate a root-cause investigation). Doc 003 (dispute tool) and doc 042 were never retrieved; doc 021 appeared only clipped.
notes: The transfer was a follow-up the customer requested after the agent believed it had resolved the issue, which matches the tier-3 'request completed, customer wants follow-up' code. The bigger policy problem came earlier: the agent rewrote rewards directly instead of having the customer file a cash back dispute (doc 003); doc 004 allows edits only after a resolved dispute.
